# Vendored: sql.js 1.10.3

SQLite compiled to WebAssembly, from the official release (`sqljs-wasm.zip`) at
https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js/releases/tag/v1.10.3. MIT license.

The live demo uses it to run the app's SQL in the browser, and the tests use it to check that
every query works the same on `node:sqlite` and on sql.js.
